spans.s:
पुङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः)
 1. The feathered part of an arrow.
 2. A falcon, a
heron.
 E. पुम् man, खन् to destroy, aff. ड.

पुङ्ग mn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गं) A heap, a collection, a quantity.
 E. पुं man, गम
to go, aff. ड ।

पुङ्गल m. (-लः) The soul.
 E. पुं man, and गल् to pervade, aff. अच्; also read पुद्गल.

पुङ्गव m. (-वः)
 1. A bull.
 2. A drug, commonly

. (In compo-
sition,) Excellent, pre-eminent.
 E. पुं male, and गौ a cow, aff. अच्.
पुङ्गवकेतु m. (-तुः) An epithet of SĪVA.
